work_completed: Scaffolded a static replay viewer under vercel/viewer/ (package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts, index.html, src/).

Implemented src/trace/parser.ts — single module that knows the nlt.observer-trace.v1 DRAFT JSONL format: validates line-1 header, fails loudly on unknown schemaVersion, tolerates unknown keys, classifies record kinds (tick, perception_sent, intent, result, decision_failed, scene_transition, scene_entities), surfaces unknown record types as parsed 'unknown' records (never dropped).

Implemented src/trace/reducer.ts — pure reducer reconstructing viewer slice state at tick N (agent positions per scene, last intent/result per agent, failures at/before tick, transitions at tick, scene_entities, unrecognized records).

Implemented views: Canvas-2D top-down (x, z) plot with per-agent shape+label markers, trails, entity markers when scene_entities exists; scene filter dropdown; play/pause/speed/scrub transport; per-tick intent/result list with verb, target, stage badge (shape+text) and reason; timeline markers for scene_transition (triangle) and decision_failed (X) with click-to-jump; summary strip (accepted/rejected by stage, failures by status code); unrecognized-records section; header meta strip.

Accessibility: identity and stage conveyed by shape + text (never colour alone); keyboard-operable scrubber (range), play/pause via Space, step via arrow keys; ARIA labels/live regions/roles throughout.

Security/static: CSP meta (default-src/script-src/style-src/img-src 'self', connect-src 'self', frame-ancestors 'none', form-action 'none'); no fetch/XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket in app code; no env vars, no secrets, no network at runtime.
Framework choice recorded: Vite + vanilla TypeScript (no runtime JS framework), Canvas 2D for plot + DOM for controls/lists.

Verified: npm ci && npm run build succeeds (clean, no warnings); tsc --noEmit passes; functional tests of parser/reducer pass (valid trace, loud schema rejection, unknown-key tolerance, tick slices, optional fields absent).
decisions_made: Framework: Vite + vanilla TypeScript, zero runtime deps, static output — guarantees npm ci && npm run build works offline and the shipped app makes no network requests.
Plot plane: x (horizontal) and z (vertical on screen); Godot y (height) is not movement, per the draft format.
Stage badge drawn from result.stage (intent carries no stage per the draft record shape).
Did not edit docs/active-threads.md, docs/contracts/*, Godot code, or the Fusion repo, per the task boundary (CC owns contracts/Fusion; avoids merge conflicts).
